title: Gwangju-Jeonnam Wildfire Pre-Watering SourceItem
description: Source-centric schema describing one external data source feeding the wildfire pre-watering decision pipeline. A SourceItem is the origin point of the layer chain: Source -> AccessOption -> Raw Snapshot / Raw Field -> Derived Dataset -> Feature -> Signal -> State -> Decision -> Action -> Feedback.

source_id.description: Stable identifier for the source. Renamed from raw_data_id.

name.description: Human-readable Korean name of the source.

domain.description: Subject area the source belongs to. Orthogonal to value_nature.

decision_relevance.description: Why this source matters for the pre-watering decision.

availability_status.description: Plan-level disposition. Renamed from `status`. REAL = will acquire from public source; MOCK = will synthesize for practice; EXCLUDE = will not acquire.

verification_status.description: Actual proof-of-life ladder for this source. Distinct from availability_status: availability is the plan, verification is the evidence. Default `unverified` until field work proves otherwise.

source_owner.description: Organization that owns and publishes the source (e.g., 산림청 국립산림과학원, 기상청, 국토지리정보원).

source_url.description: Canonical URL where the source is published, requested, or documented. Acquisition-ready REAL sources must use a concrete dataset/API/layer URL, not a generic homepage. May be empty string for MOCK/EXCLUDE entries with no public origin, or for REAL entries whose acquisition_method is to_be_verified.

acquisition_method.description: How a Raw Snapshot is taken from the source.

auth_required.description: What authentication the source requires before a Raw Snapshot can be taken.

expected_format.description: Comma-separated list of formats the source emits (e.g., 'JSON, XML', 'SHP, GeoJSON').

storage_path.description: Convention-bound path under data/ where Raw Snapshots from this source are stored. REAL sources must target data/raw/<SOURCE_ID>/snapshots/; MOCK sources data/mock/<SOURCE_ID>/scenario_baseline/. Empty string allowed for EXCLUDE.

value_nature.description: Kind of value the source carries. Orthogonal to domain. A weather source may be observed or forecast; a forest source may be a geospatial_base_layer or a static_reference.

temporal_semantics.description: What time semantics the source carries. Forecast sources carry both forecast_issued_at and forecast_valid_time; static reference layers carry `static`.

temporal_resolution.description: Free-text detail not captured by temporal_semantics or freshness_class. Examples: '3-hour interval, 72-hour horizon', '1일 8회 발표, 시간별 예보', 'minute/hour/day', 'scenario-defined'.

spatial_semantics.description: Geometry types the source carries. A road network carries both line and point (intersections); a registry table may carry no_geometry.

spatial_resolution.description: Free-text detail not captured by spatial_semantics. Examples: '5km grid', '시군구 polygon', 'building polygon', 'station/center address'.

freshness_class.description: How fresh data from this source typically is. Replaces the old free-text update_frequency field.

confidence_class.description: Trust class of values from this source. Drives downstream confidence propagation into Features/Signals.

raw_fields.description: Field/column names a Raw Snapshot from this source is expected to contain. Korean field names allowed. Empty array permitted for sources whose schema is not yet inventoried.

derived_outputs.description: Derived Datasets and intermediate columns produced from this source. DERIVED_* IDs preserved unchanged.

used_by_features.description: Features that depend on this source (directly or via Derived Datasets). Feature names preserved unchanged.

access_option_ids.description: All AccessOptions registered for this Source, including candidate, selected, fallback, and rejected options.

candidate_access_option_ids.description: AccessOptions still under evaluation. Candidate options are not assumed usable until verified.

selected_access_option_id.description: Selected AccessOption for acquisition. Null until an option is selected after discovery/key verification.

fallback_access_option_ids.description: AccessOptions that remain usable if the selected option fails or has insufficient coverage.

exclusion_or_mock_reason.description: Reason a source is MOCK or EXCLUDE. Empty string for REAL sources.
